name: Porto's Bakery (Buena Park, CA) Famous "Refugiado" Guava & Cream Cheese Pastry
whyItWorks: Porto's world-famous flaky puff pastry filled with smooth, seedless guava jam and sweet cream cheese. Guava jam is strained completely smooth with zero seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Refugiado fresh and warm from the bakery line.
